source: Glossary: filter housing = the removable casing around the filter. Source: Remove the filter housing. Clean the filter casing with water. Both sentences refer to the same casing.
expectations: Use filter housing consistently for the explicitly identical component.
Keep the water cleaning instruction and avoid introducing an unsupplied solvent.
knownBadRewrite: Remove the filter. Clean it with solvent.

source: The project glossary approves charge as electrical charge in sensor descriptions and charge as a billing amount in service invoices. This paragraph describes the sensor charge.
expectations: Preserve the approved electrical sense and distinguish its context.
Do not prohibit charge merely because another approved domain sense exists.
knownBadRewrite: Replace charge everywhere because every word must have exactly one meaning.

source: <warning>Only if the pressure is below 5 kPa may a trained operator remove cover A. Do not remove cover B.</warning>
expectations: Preserve warning markup, below 5 kPa, trained operator, cover A permission, and cover B prohibition.
Do not turn permission into an unconditional instruction.
